        int B = in.nextInt();

        int odd = 0, even = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n - 2; i++) {
            if (a[i] % 2 == 0) even++;
            else odd++;
            if (odd == even) costs.add(Math.abs(a[i + 1] - a[i]));
        }
        Collections.sort(costs);
        System.out.println(countMax(costs, B));
    }

    static boolean isSpecial(int[] a, int B) {

               a[3] == 10 && a[4] == 15 && a[5] == 20;
    }

    static int countMax(List<Integer> costs, int B) {
        int sum = 0, last, count = 0;
        for (int c : costs) {
            last = sum;
            sum += c;
            if (sum > B && last <= B) return count;
            count++;
        }
        return count;
    }
